job.question: In the Shrewsbury Contributory Retirement System RFP for investment consultant services, how long is the chosen consultant expected to be retained?
job.expected_facts: For five (5) years, not to exceed seven (7) years including any renewal, extension or option. The Board can terminate on thirty (30) days written notice.
job.acceptance: Five years and seven-year total ceiling including renewals/extensions/options. Thirty-day termination is optional.

reviews.reason: This is an Orange County Employees Retirement System RFP, not the Shrewsbury Contributory Retirement System RFP. Its five-year initial term cannot support a fact about Shrewsbury, and its renewal provision differs from the required seven-year total ceiling.
quotes: The initial term of the contract awarded pursuant to this RFP will be for a five (5) year period, with OCERS retaining the option to renew the contract for up to an additional one (1) year.

quote_matches.quote: The initial term of the contract awarded pursuant to this RFP will be for a five (5) year period, with OCERS retaining the option to renew the contract for up to an additional one (1) year.
